scope.conditional_verifier: independent edge-fixed DP and within-group Bernoulli enumeration

limitations: ESS is not independently recomputed; all saved masks, ranges, screens and raw-scale MCSE identities are checked.
Saved ADMM residuals and first-hit stopping times are checked logically, not reconstructed from solver trajectories.
Stored latent angles/uniforms are used to rebuild A/P; no new random data or fits are generated.
Scalar likelihood/count residuals are recomputed at four fixed retained positions per chain; all scalar draws enter R-hat and MCSE checks.
Finite-computation review-flag selection and CSV presentation are not independently regenerated here.
